# Gallery

Screenshots of the running app, kept as a progress record and as ready-made
assets for the README and any landing page. Every image here was captured
from the real application, not mocked up.

**Do not edit this file by hand** — it is generated by
`node scripts/build-gallery.mjs` from `manifest.json`. To add a shot, add an
entry to the manifest and re-run.

## The console

### First launch over Austin

Google photorealistic 3D tiles under the sensor HUD: classification banner, MGRS and lat/lon readout, GSD and NIIRS, and the mission-control launcher. Cesium ion and Google Maps attribution stays visible, as their licences require.

![First launch over Austin](globe-boot.jpg)

### Live street traffic over Westminster

2,213 vehicles tracking the London road network from OpenStreetMap geometry and TomTom flow. The HUD reverse-geocodes the view unprompted — here, Big Ben and Parliament.

![Live street traffic over Westminster](traffic-london.jpg)

### Submarine cables, global

712 cable routes and 1,917 landing points from TeleGeography — 2,629 entities of static reference geometry.

![Submarine cables, global](submarine-cables.jpg)

### Saved places

Bookmark the complete view — camera, style, layers, panels — and replay it mid-session. ALL replays everything; POS replays position only.

![Saved places](saved-places.jpg)

## Wonders

### Colosseum, Rome

GSD 0.10 m — the sharpest site in the set. The hypogeum floor is legible inside the arena.

![Colosseum, Rome](wonders-colosseum.jpg)

### Chichén Itzá, Mexico

GSD 0.11 m. El Castillo centre-frame with the Temple of the Warriors and the ball court.

![Chichén Itzá, Mexico](wonders-chichen-itza.jpg)

### Great Pyramid of Giza

Full photogrammetry — the pyramid mass and the mastaba field, with Cairo behind.

![Great Pyramid of Giza](wonders-giza.jpg)

### Taj Mahal, Agra

GSD 0.17 m. The complex, its four minarets and the charbagh gardens, with the Yamuna beyond.

![Taj Mahal, Agra](wonders-taj-mahal.jpg)

### Christ the Redeemer, Rio de Janeiro

The statue on the Corcovado summit with Rio and the Atlantic behind. This framing took three attempts — see docs/DESTINATIONS.md.

![Christ the Redeemer, Rio de Janeiro](wonders-redeemer.jpg)

## Orbit

### Orbit — start

Press O after flying to a destination and the camera circles it at about 6°/sec, a full revolution in roughly a minute. These three frames are the same landmark ~7 seconds apart.

## Conflict

### Conflict watch — Eastern Mediterranean

The Conflict watch saved place recalled: live vessels, civil and military flights, and mapped installations, at 150 km. NASA FIRMS is deliberately off — see docs/CONFLICT-VIEW.md for why.

![Conflict watch — Eastern Mediterranean](conflict-emed.jpg)
